convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a non-standard indicator 'i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR' and depends on an external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for all position open/close logic, money management, and new-bar detection.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades
tnn1 - FFT size derived from N
TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for trade signal timestamps

other_exits: BuyPosClose called when indicator turns down (Value[1]>Value[2]) and BuyPosClose input is true; SellPosClose called when indicator turns up (Value[1]<Value[2]) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots); MMMode=FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE means MM is a fraction of equity/balance/free-margin/loss-adjusted-balance used as risk per trade. Actual sizing logic is inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a spectral analysis filter (i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR) which applies FFT-based smoothing to WPR (Williams Percent Range). The signal logic: when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator was rising on prior completed bar), and Value[0]>=Value[1] (current bar continues rising or equal), a buy signal is generated. Conversely, when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator was falling) and Value[0]<=Value[1], a sell signal is generated. Signal evaluation only occurs on new bars (NB.IsNewBar) or on SignalBar=0 (every tick). Entry signals are gated by boolean inputs BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen. Exit signals are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose. The trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are all from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and their internal logic (position existence checks, margin validation, order retry) is not visible in this file. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup is also from the library.
python_conversion_notes: The i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR custom indicator requires reverse-engineering or sourcing its source code to replicate in Python - it is an FFT-smoothed WPR with N controlling the FFT window (2^N) and SS controlling the spectral smoothing. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains all money management (5 modes), position open/close, new-bar detection, and global variable cleanup logic that must be reimplemented. The position_gate is 'any' from this EA's perspective but the library functions may internally check for existing positions - this must be verified from the .mqh source. The signal logic itself (3-bar comparison of the custom indicator buffer) is straightforward once the indicator is replicated. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips are large and likely already point-adjusted (not needing digit multiplication), but this should be confirmed against the library's order-sending code.
